objective: 把L-DAMP做实，完整且有可信结果
scope: Complete complex multiuser AFDM L-DAMP adaptation with learned joint-channel denoising and verified matrix Onsager correction; all negative evidence retained
requirements: Audit original sources and adaptations, preserve existing model for comparison
Verify transforms, complex covariance conventions, complete denoiser derivatives and AMP recurrence independently
Train a denoiser that uses full user channel and public noise information; report convergence and held-out denoising including inactive users
Test fixed actual queries before using a new denoiser in the recurrence; retain all failures
Freeze selected architecture, weights, iteration/probe settings and activity rule before new-scene validation
Compare full-channel NMSE, misses, false alarms and runtime on matched inputs with uncertainty grouped by physical scene
Deliver reproducible training/inference/evaluation entry points, model provenance, report and current documentation; test public installed implementation

initial_controls.backbone: 20 Conv layers, width 64, BN/ReLU, 32 real signal channels + 16 log variance channels
initial_controls.profile_mixture: 75% previously observed public development variance profiles, 25% equal variance
initial_controls.selection: Equal average of six variance-band validation full-error/signal ratios; subsequent actual-query and receiver testing is development, never independent validation

preconditioning.s: Training-population per-beam complex second moment times target activity probability
preconditioning.v: Public residual per-beam complex variance (synthetic known variance in denoiser training)
preconditioning.identity_control: c_skip=1, c_out=sqrt(v/2); same network input and weighted physical error objective
preconditioning.noise_conditioning: log(v)/4 constant channel maps; fixed channel positions preserve beam identity
preconditioning.derivatives: Hold public variance fixed; differentiate all query-dependent operations; retain full cross-beam partial Jacobian in joint model

evidence_rules: Synthetic Gaussian denoising results are not receiver results
No truth-driven normalization, stopping, network selection or inference
No claim of state evolution for finite structured AFDM operator
Author reference has dominant DC background; cannot establish AFDM utility
Not a literal He-model reproduction: conditioning, preconditioning and complex multibeam model are explicit adaptations
Existing failed 32-channel models are controls, not proof joint denoising is inferior
next: Run derivative checks, prepare fixed transformed training bank, execute matched training controls
